newsitem.title: ITALY: RUGBY UNION-ITALY CAPTAIN DOUBTFUL FOR AUSTRALIA TEST.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-ITALY CAPTAIN DOUBTFUL FOR AUSTRALIA TEST.

text.p: Captain Massimo Cuttitta looks set to miss Italy's rugby union international against Australia in Padua on October 23 because of a muscle strain.

The Italian federation said in a statement on Monday that Milan forward Cuttitta had injured himself during a Europa Cup match against Irish club Munster last weekend and would be replaced by Benetton Treviso player Mauro dal Sie.
However a federation official told Reuters later that Cuttitta would still be named in the squad and it was premature to rule him out, although he looked doubtful.
Second row Pierpaolo Pedroni was also unlikely to play due to injury and the federation said in the statement that he would probably be replaced by Treviso's Walter Cristofoletto.
Coach Georges Coste is to name the 21-man squad after Italy A play the Wallabies in Catania on Saturday.
